scope.flow: HypoVault share accounting: constructor sets totalSupply with ghost shares never minted to any account, affecting deposit minting and withdrawal redemption formulas

statements.text: HypoVault's constructor sets totalSupply to include 1 000 000 shares.
The 1 000 000 shares counted in totalSupply are never minted to any account, so they have zero corresponding balances.
Both key share-minting and redemption formulas use totalSupply as a scaling factor, so the phantom shares enter the denominator.
The ERC-20 invariant totalSupply == sum(balanceOf[]) must hold so that share-minting and redemption formulas fairly prorate deposits, withdrawals, and profits.
Deposits over-mint: new entrants receive more shares than their fair pro-rata allocation, diluting incumbents.
Withdrawals under-pay: redemptions release fewer assets per share because the denominator is artificially inflated.
Over time value is stealthily skimmed into the void, permanently disadvantaging honest users.
